title: The Pioneers SMP
description: This is the official modpack for the Pioneers SMP
body:
This modpack is the offical modpack used for the Pioneers SMP.
When we go to a new season, I'll (Dave/owner) will update the modpack accordingly. 
Within the modpack you can turn off any mods you feel, you don't need. Some mods are designed for content creation, some mods are just gameplay, some mods are designed for stability within the game.
